mapper.select: SELECT O.* FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = 1 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_SERVER S WHERE S.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND S.SERVER_ID = #{serverId} ) OR O.ORDER_NO = ( SELECT BS.ORDER_NO FROM BUSINESS_SERVER BS WHERE BS.ID = #{serverId} AND BS.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ) ) ORDER BY O.CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT O.* FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = 1 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_SERVER S WHERE S.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND S.SERVER_ID = #{serverId} ) OR O.ORDER_NO = ( SELECT BS.ORDER_NO FROM BUSINESS_SERVER BS WHERE BS.ID = #{serverId} AND BS.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ) ) ORDER BY O.CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT O.* FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_SERVER S ON O.ORDER_NO = S.ORDER_NO WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus} AND S.SERVER_ID = #{serverId}
